Hi Carlos / Emma / Kaito —

Thanks again for your time on the intro call last week. We heard that execs from each org would like to join a short 45-minute walkthrough of Redwood’s inference platform (high level + time for Q&A). Because we have stakeholders across San Francisco, Paris, and Tokyo, I pulled a few windows that should hit reasonable local hours for everyone. Please reply with which one you prefer or share any hard constraints.

Proposed windows (all shown in local & UTC for clarity):
- Option A: 2026-12-08 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 GMT / 02:00 JST (next day) — early for APAC
- Option B: 2026-12-08 16:00 PT / 19:00 ET / 00:00 GMT (Dec 9) / 09:00 JST (Dec 9) — evening US, good for APAC morning
- Option C: 2026-12-09 07:00 PT / 10:00 ET / 15:00 GMT / 00:00 JST (next day) — awkward for APAC

A few notes:
- There was some calendar drift on earlier invites due to DST differences between US/EU in October — I triple-checked all times in UTC to avoid that.
- Attaching a quick .ics with these three options (proposed-times.ics) to make it easy to drop into calendars.

If you prefer, we can run two 30-minute sessions (one for APAC-friendly and one for US/EU-friendly) instead of asking execs to join at odd hours. 

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
